name: main
notes: VGAME entry from c0_start: comm/pilot ptrs, bind drivers, pages, gfxlib init, sim_init, sim_run, joystick calib copy-back, exit(DS:008D)

name: sim_init
notes: all loading: world import, STFLT.3DX, theatre files, speech.117, palette, 256pit.PIC, ordnance panel, cockpit blit

name: cockpit_palette_refresh
notes: pal_flight_load() then falls into cockpit_daynight_recolor; called from cba0

name: cockpit_daynight_recolor
notes: 10A8:0004 asm HUD init then 3 rect_recolor (day 0F->0A, night 0A->0F) on page-2 ctx 4012

name: sim_run
notes: timer_install, keypad hook, frame_loop, sound off, world export, frees, jmp timer_remove

name: gfx_pages_init
notes: page0=A000 -> 85E2/85EA, page1=gfx_alloc(1) -> 85E4, page2=comm[20h] -> 85E6; page_seg_set_b for 1 and 2

name: ordnance_panel_build
notes: ordnance.pic -> page 1; 2 or 4 weapon strips 77x15 to page 2 at (169,110+15i); sprite_grab 77x60 -> BA0E

name: r3d_scene_draw
type: void r3d_scene_draw(int yaw_neg,int pitch,int roll,long x,long y,long z,int x0,int y0,int w,int h)
notes: Scene entry: window ctx 344, 04bb delay, dae8 camera+sky, 04da terrain, 9aca, db3e, a17e

name: frame_delay
notes: Busy-wait ticks increments of byte DS:264A (timer tick); arg = DS:43B8 frame-rate menu value

name: r3d_draw_terrain
type: void r3d_draw_terrain(int heading_neg,int pitch,long x,long y,long z)
notes: terrain+scenery: levels 4..1, cells far->near per view octant, records -> E7AC; cull cells with E8A2 (path A)

name: terr_to_level
notes: world units -> level units (L4 >>6, L3 >>4, L2 >>2, L1 x1, L0 x2; rounded)

name: terr_tile_type
notes: tile type from 8x8(B00C)/16x16(9F68)/child tables(9D10,9B08,9904); 0 if out of range

name: load_3dx_banks
notes: theatre .3DX -> bank1 (B760), PHOTO.3DX -> bank2 (B762), flag tables, id table 0510, mission prop entries, KU remap

name: load_3dt_scenery
notes: .3dT: type counts 0614, rec counts 061E, 7-byte records at A06A, ptr table E304[32*level+type]

name: load_3dg_terrain
notes: .3dG: L3 map 9F68, L2 9D10, L1 9B08, L0 9904; copies 64-byte L4 theatre table 0A68+64*t to B00C

name: set_file_ext
notes: replace text from first . (or NUL) with ext; used on the stem buffer

name: terr_find_scenery_at
notes: Nearest scenery object at world point (x=cell<<5, y=(0x8000-cell)<<5); fills hit record BA14; returns BA14 or 0

name: terr_set_scenery_state
notes: Records new id of a hit scenery object in table B772 (5-byte recs, count 9902) or tile entry; sets bit7 of tile entry+6

name: terr_scenery_override
type: int terr_scenery_override(int level,int idx,int cx,int cy)
notes: search mission override table DS:B772 (5-byte entries, count 9902) backwards; returns new object or 0

name: terr_probe_point
notes: Scenery collision probe: nearest solid object in tile then 11eb:01b8 point test; result in byte C686

name: map_render_terrain
notes: Map MFD terrain: dae8 top-down camera, 11f2 tile walk, db3e; only caller 8387

name: map_draw_tiles
notes: Walks tile levels 4..0, tile object lists, calls 13e3 per object (3DX top-down draw)

name: map_tile_bounds
notes: Visible tile range of the map window using 13ac, clamped 0..94E0-1

name: map_draw_object
notes: Draw one 3DX scenery object top-down via 1433:03a9, e54b, 11eb:00d3 (class filter 94E6)

name: r3d_draw_sky_ground
notes: 16 sky bands (col 0x80+i) + 16 ground bands (0x70+i) as polygons 1001:01ec; flat fill if 98DE<3; caches sin/cos to 98C8/98E4/98F8/9F12

name: cockpit_draw_adi
notes: Attitude indicator 32x28 at (265,140): horizon polygon col 1 on col 9, bezel 91a4, copy back page to screen; only C07A==0

name: mfd_view_sky_bands
notes: up to 16 sky quads colours 80h+i above horizon row, clamped at y=6Eh; table DS:0D22

name: mfd_view_ground_bands
notes: up to 16 ground quads colours 70h+i (F0h if mode==1) below horizon, clamped at y=A9h

name: fx_explosion_sprite
notes: explosion animation frame (18-entry far-ptr table DS:9188) via sprite_scaled slot 22; w=size h=size-size/4 at (x-size/2,y-size/2)

name: r3d_sprite_main
type: void r3d_sprite_main(int x,int y,int size,int cls)
notes: 2D scaled sprite (slot 22) centred at x,y, height 3/4 size, ctx=[0344]; far ptr DS:91D8[cls]

name: r3d_sprite_tv
type: void r3d_sprite_tv(int x,int y,int size,int cls)
notes: same as 1AD6 but ctx=[4042] (target camera window)

name: frame_loop
notes: saves bp si di es and calls frame_loop_body

name: timer_install
notes: [2636]=[2640]=1, clock=0, timer_calibrate, save INT 8 in cs:1CEB, install timer_isr, [262B]=1

name: timer_remove
notes: reached by jmp from sim_run: PIT ch0 mode 36h count 0, restore INT 8, [262B]=0, ret to main

name: timer_rate_fast
notes: jmp target of tick work when snd_poll>0: [2636]=[2639], [2630]=[263B]/[2636], [2638]=1

name: timer_isr
notes: INT 8: clock+=[2632]; every [2636]-th call a tick (resync, [262A]=0, tick work); snd_noise if [2636]!=1; EOI or chain to BIOS per 65536 clocks

name: timer_resync
notes: every 20th tick: wait for vertical retrace and reload PIT ch0 with [2632]; disables itself if no retrace seen

name: pit_read_retrace
notes: wait retrace start on 3DAh (3BAh mono) then latch and read PIT ch0; 0 on timeout

name: timer_tick_work
notes: [2646]++,[264A]++,[2648]++, slot 46 explosion_fx_tick, snd_poll on 6 of 7 ticks, result steers 1C5B/1C73

name: sim_input_flight
notes: per-frame: key read+dispatch, stick, player aircraft model (attitude/speed/alt/fuel/G/eject), history ring

name: fm_rotate_apply
notes: fm_mat = A x B via 2DDC; every 8th sets dirty

name: view_frame
notes: View+cockpit frame: camera per C07A mode, matrix B156, picture reload, calls 03ce, cockpit overlays, sets 2E34

name: view_cam_front
notes: cases 0 and 0x44: camera angles = aircraft yaw/pitch/roll

name: cockpit_refresh_panels
notes: After pit picture reload: re-light lit lamps (tab 46D8), 80a0(DEDA), 8113(DFDC), 38f8, 3926, 44a9

name: sim_frame_step
notes: Per-frame simulation step (once per 1bbc iteration): grid pos, init, map markers, updaters, airfield/landing/ground checks, 1 Hz clock, fps estimator, 43ee

name: sim_init_first_call
notes: First-call mission init block (C0AE==1), falls into 3b6a; ends C0AE=2, 38f8, screen_on

name: sim_frame_body
notes: Per-step body after init: world clamp, map markers, 4f2a/5730/671a, effects, airfield logic

name: sim_airfield_scan
notes: Every 8th step: nearest friendly/neutral airfield DFE0, 98F2; rebuild airfield objects O[ded0-1..4]

name: sim_airfield_traffic
notes: Every 128 steps: spawn traffic object via 65d4 and rotate C0B6->C600->DE8C counters

name: sim_airfield_zone
notes: Fuel speech, airfield zone box, take-off line, cargo delivery, landing detection (mission_end(0))

name: sim_terrain_check
notes: Terrain collision: crash mode -> mission_end(2), else lift +500

name: sim_second_tick
notes: 3D60++ and once per fps steps mission clock, palette drift, deadline event, event log

name: sim_fps_estimate
notes: Every 4*fps steps: fps estimator from timer ticks and DED6 recount

name: sim_key_and_signature
notes: cba0(DE90) key dispatcher then radar signature 3D5C (bank, speed/AGL, power, gear, bay, radar)

name: hud_draw_store_count
notes: Draw 2-digit store count of type 1 flare 2 chaff 3 decoy in panel field 3D9C[type] via d92d

name: wpn_release_countermeasure
notes: Release flare/chaff/decoy: decrement 3636[type], fill slot R[] at 39AA, timers, message "<name> released", sound 0xF

name: wpn_cm_tick
notes: Per-step countdown of the 4 countermeasure slots; decoy lamp 7 via 898b

name: wpn_gun_update
notes: Move gun bullets (E44E, 12 B) and spawn on fire button: ammo 3650, vel from heading/pitch, sound 6

name: fx_smoke_update
notes: Smoke puffs (39DA x16 x8 B) over burning site 3D68: age+=4, y drift, spawn every 8 steps

name: fx_fall_update
notes: Falling body C602 altitude, B756 velocity (gravity -12/step, min -16)

name: sim_reset_clock_palette
notes: Seed rand, reset cockpit (784a), 3D60 random, start clock 9870, 98E2=0, palette pre-steps toward day/night table

name: mission_cheat_rearm
notes: Training cheat (Alt-R): clear damage, bays 9/1, gun 1000, fuel 5000

name: mission_end
notes: Set E552=1, write comm+28/26/74/76/34/36, log event 8; code 7 aborts; non-zero codes ignored while C06E!=0

name: mission_log_event
notes: Append 6-byte record {98E2,px>>7,py>>7,code,aux} to DS:BA2A (max 255), terminator code=0

name: msg_site_label
notes: Build "Noun at Place" label for site in DS:9876 (max 24 chars + ".")

name: site_name
notes: builds site place/noun name into DS:9876 (max 18 chars + ".")

name: mission_world_import
notes: unpack comm+7Ah blob, build name pointer table DEDC, start position BA10/BA12 and C02A/C02C from slot0 anchor site

name: mission_name_targets
notes: Give each mission target object its own name entry (clone class attr + string, re-class world cell, T.+14)

name: mission_world_export
notes: blob fields to comm+7Ah plus 0x600-byte event log BA2A; called at the end of sim_run (also on quit)

name: wld_blob_fields
notes: ordered list of 16 DGROUP fields copied to/from the world blob via wld_blob_copy

name: wld_blob_copy
notes: movedata between DS:p and blob cursor 94EC (dir by DE8E: 1 import, 0 export); cursor += n

name: pal_time_of_day_step
notes: Once per second: every 16 s step one palette colour range 1 unit toward day/night table and upload

name: hud_glideslope_update
notes: Compute glide-slope state 46C2 (0 gear up,1,2 ok,3) from slope angle vs 7.98 deg tolerance

name: hud_lamp_timers
notes: Count down chaff/flare/aux indicator timers and set lamps 0xE/0xF/0x18 via 4f05

name: hud_lamp_set
notes: If cockpit visible and lamp state differs call d83e(3FE2,lamp,on)

name: hud_threat_update
notes: Stealth bars from 3D5C, staggered site scheduler calling 516d, threat arrow 8548/863c; 3D6A--

name: det_site_radar_update
notes: Per-site radar scan: 5460 signal, bars, "detected" msg, level build-up, "Radar ID" msg, SAM launch into DS:3C0C slot site&7

name: det_radar_signal
notes: Radar formula: (maxr-D)*cell*(2*skill+factor+1)/maxr, aspect/Doppler factor, altitude cone, halved for Lockheed model; D=dist>>6

name: det_radar_warning
notes: [3D92]=2*[3660] warning lamp timer; snd_cmd 8 via d6bf(8,1)

name: det_alert_network
notes: Alert: [3D62]=[B286], last known player pos/alt/heading, raise every radar level to floor 16*(war+skill-1)

name: ai_update_units
notes: Per-step AI of all enemy aircraft units (36B at DS:C13E): modes patrol/hunt/RTB, steering, crash, landing msgs, scramble, calls 62d0/65d4

name: ai_unit_radar
notes: Aircraft radar via 5460, level build-up, "Visual ID - X" msg, air-to-air missile launch "W fired by X", lock tone snd 7

name: ai_unit_takeoff
notes: Place unit on airbase (carrier z=0x8C), flags|=0x403, endurance, msg "<site> - <type> taking off"

name: wpn_proj_update_all
notes: per-step update of the 12 projectile slots (0-7 enemy, 8-11 player): seeker/decoys, steering, move, impact, proximity burst, messages

name: wpn_seeker_check
type: int(int slot,int tx,int ty,int tz,int cls)
notes: 22.5 deg cone / rear-aspect test of projectile vs point; sets [94F4] dist [94F6] bearing; tz unused

name: dmg_unit_kill
notes: marks unit u dead (flags 0x20), logs event 3/0x83, name to 9876, sound 5, mission_target_done(0) for primary air target

name: dmg_object_destroy
notes: destroys ground object o: flag 0x80, wreck shape, mission target k (kind 2) done, event log 1/0xC/2, sound 5

name: mission_target_done
notes: primary/secondary target achieved: sets 9B05 0x40/0x20 and 2E7C 1/2/3; 9876 = Primary target or Second. target; logs 0x8B/0x4B for kinds 3/4

name: dmg_player_blast
notes: skill+1 random bits into [3632] damage mask and [C5C8]++; lamps 10..16 refresh; [98EE]=1; sound 4; no-op in training

name: wpn_release
notes: fire key: checks roll/bay/altitude, takes a store from the selected bay, fills a free projectile slot 8-11 or transfers fuel; messages Bay closed etc.

name: dmg_wobj_destroyable
notes: 1 if the world object found in [9F10] is not yet the wreck shape (C0AC or DEA4 by class)

name: cockpit_widgets_reset
notes: mission-start reset of panel widgets (d83e x4), [409C]=0, [DFDC]=0x18; called from 4857

name: hud_overlay_frame
notes: per-frame HUD C part: flash, lamps 0-2, stall lamp, weapon/gun line, crosshair, tapes, AAM circle, speed/alt numbers, waypoint caret, message, view 42 altitude

name: mfd_left_select
notes: left MFD mode 0 map / 1 scope; lamp 22/23 via d83e; F3

name: mfd_right_select
notes: right MFD page 0x13 TV 0x14 nav 0x15 weapons 0x18 objectives; lamp via DS:4068

name: mfd_tv_label
notes: Ahead/Right/Rear/Left label at (197,193) on ctx0 from DS:E556

name: mfd_refresh
notes: page 0x16 = update 7 damage lamps (898b 10..16); redraw right MFD if page == DFDC

name: mfd_init_geometry
notes: sets DEDA=0 and left MFD rect vars then tail-jumps into 8498 (one zoom-in)

name: hud_threat_bar
notes: Signal bar: x 0x56..0x56+val/2 (val>0) or 0x88+val/2..0x88 (val<0), rows 0xBB+y0..0xBB+y1 via 1001:024C on ctx [3FE2]

name: mfd_map_redraw
notes: Left MFD map: centre (4084,4086) clamped ahead of aircraft, 119c terrain, site icons 8548, 973c; DEDA=0

name: mfd_zoom_in
notes: z key: map zoom DS:4080 <9 / scope zoom DS:4082 <7 / camera range 3D70-- in views with bit 0x80

name: mfd_zoom_out
notes: x key: map zoom >2 / scope zoom !=0 / 3D70++

name: mfd_map_plot

name: mfd_map_to_screen
notes: World->map screen coords, returns 1 if strictly inside the map window

name: mfd_map_arc
type: void(int cx,int cy,int r,int color,int solid,int a0,int a1)

name: mfd_map_line

name: hud_line_full

name: hud_ils
notes: F9 ILS needles: localiser x 139..181, glide slope y 40..72, label "ILS"

name: r3d_draw_world_objects

name: r3d_matrix_row_dot

name: r3d_view_depth
